subject.title: feat(ui): add settings profile page with lifetime token stats, streaks, and activity heatmap

question: Should OpenClaw core add this first-party Settings > Profile usage summary page now?
rationale: The implementation fits existing Usage/Gateway boundaries, but it is a new prominent core UI feature and the protected maintainer label means product acceptance should be explicit rather than inferred from automation.

options.title: Approve Core Profile After Live Proof
options.body: Accept the new core settings page once a redacted live Gateway run and CI follow-up are present.

options.title: Narrow Back To Usage
options.body: Ask the contributor to move only the useful aggregate fields or smaller stats into the existing Usage page if a separate identity page is not desired.

options.title: Pause Product Direction
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open while maintainers decide whether this belongs in core, a dashboard iteration, or a later UX milestone.

recommendation.title: Approve Core Profile After Live Proof
recommendation.body: Accept the new core settings page once a redacted live Gateway run and CI follow-up are present.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent UI lifecycle ownership makes this the best available routing candidate for the core Control UI product choice, though final authority may involve other maintainers.
